_source: HCM 7th Edition, Chapter 32, TWSC Example Problem 4: four-leg TWSC intersection on a four-lane major street (N = 2 through lanes per direction, no left-turn lanes, so the major-street left turn shares the through lane), no minor-street through movements, no median storage (one stage). The intersection lies between two coordinated upstream signals, so Step 5b (Equations 20-19 through 20-21) applies. Demand values are the published peak 15-min flow rates from Exhibit 32-13 (image), so phf = null. Heavy-vehicle percentage is 1% (from the published t_c,1 = 4.1 + 2.0(0.01) = 4.12 s). Proportion-of-time-blocked inputs p_b,x are the Chapter 30 movement-based access-point output published in Exhibit 32-12 (image): p_b for the major-street left turns and minor-street right turns = 0.170; p_b for the minor-street left turns = 0.260. Conflicting-flow overrides reproduce the published v_c,7 = 1,827 and v_c,10 = 1,832 veh/h; the 7th Edition Exhibit 20-16 factors used by this library give 1,874 and 1,879 because the worked example drops the major-street right-turn term (0.5 v_6 for movement 7, 0.5 v_3 for movement 10) in Stage II (see VERIFY-HCM note in src/hcm/chapter20/twsc.rs). Minor-street approaches have an exclusive left lane and an exclusive right lane (Exhibit 32-12 lane data: L = 1, T = 0, R = 1), modeled as 'Separate'.
